L-DYN.note: addBundler on the RC -> a registered bundler deploys its vault -> the RC subscribes from react() -> the Hub binds that vault (rcVault delivered); spec §12 L-DYN, C-08

L-PAY.note: a Hub with zero reserves and only a balance receives its first callback (any kind): paid from the balance, debt 0 (spec §12 L-PAY, T-HUB-PAY (c), s2 D1-01)

L-CON-AA.note: L-CON-AA: Action on the origin vault (script/live/drive.py) -> the RC reaction on Lasna -> the first Applied with seq >= its own on the destination Hub (spec §9.5, PB-17)

L-CON-AB.note: L-CON-AB: Action on the origin vault (script/live/drive.py) -> the RC reaction on Lasna -> the first Applied with seq >= its own on the destination Hub (spec §9.5, PB-17)

L-SPOOF.note: a third-party RC's rcConduct to the 1301 Hub: rejected (NotRc, word 0 = the third party, no Hub log, conduct(99) zero); the charge 145558050000 wei (billed: True) (OQ-18, PB-12)

L-GAS-partial.note: one delivery per (chain, kind) at exactly its gasLimit; the Hub entry gas from a parity trace; F = gasLimit - entry*64/63 (spec §5.6, OQ-19); missing or failing: ['11155111/exit']

L-CRON.note: Cron subscribed in the reaction to the retire (B3 gone) and unsubscribed by a Cron reaction after the patient exit was DONE, one interval; every other subscription change in the window was made by a non-Cron reaction (listed with its trigger in otherChanges) (spec §9.5, C-10)

L-CON-BA.note: L-CON-BA: Action on the origin vault (script/live/drive.py) -> the RC reaction on Lasna -> the first Applied with seq >= its own on the destination Hub (spec §9.5, PB-17)

L-CON-BB.note: L-CON-BB: Action on the origin vault (script/live/drive.py) -> the RC reaction on Lasna -> the first Applied with seq >= its own on the destination Hub (spec §9.5, PB-17)

L-PAUSE.note: L-PAUSE: a 1301 breach of X_A (BreachLatched, script/live/drive.py breach) -> the RC reaction on Lasna -> Applied on the 11155111 Hub (paused there from that block) -> the agent's next agentAllocate reverts HubPaused (spec §9.5, C-02)

L-OFFLINE.note: L-OFFLINE: the agent's last allocation landed before the breach, it sent nothing until after the pause was delivered (nonce + 1), and that allocation was refused (spec §3.7, §9.5, C-03)

L-PLAN.note: L-PLAN: each X_A EpochRecorded (drive.py poke) -> the RC reaction -> its rcAllocate -> the PLAN note on the 1301 Hub: DONE before the breach, SKIPPED(PAUSED) after it (spec §3.7, §9.5)

L-EXIT-partial.note: L-EXIT: a 1301 breach of X_A -> processBreach (the forfeit set aside; its shares recorded) -> the RC's rcExit answers (EARLY while the drip runs) -> ExitDone after the drip: the tokens to the owner only, in kind, equal to the note (spec §3.5, §9.5, C-04, C-12)

stats.method: end-to-end = destination block time - origin block time (both read by RPC); legs unclamped (+/-1 s skew); a coalesced loop ends at the first Applied with seq >= its own; undelivered after 4 h count as 14400 s (p95 a lower bound when > 5% are undelivered); nearest-rank p95; Ethereum Sepolia destinations have a one-block (~12 s) floor
